newsitem.title: USA: Rubin--any CPI change should be expertly grounded.
newsitem.headline: Rubin--any CPI change should be expertly grounded.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Wednesday said that any attempt to repair the bias in the Consumer Price Index should be based on expert opinion rather than on political grounds.
In testimony before the Senate Finance Committe, Rubin said that there is almost universal agreement that the CPI as currently formulated is incorrect.
"The real question is, can we find an expert opinion basis for an adjustment that is expertly grounded rather than politically grounded?" he said.
